bio: Hotel du Vin Winchester is a boutique hotel in the heart of one of England's oldest cities. Built in 1715, this Queen Anne-style building is close to the historic cathedral and Winchester's shops and attractions.  Hotel du Vin offers a classic Afternoon Tea menu, which is the perfect combination of sweet and savoury. Enjoy a selection of finger sandwiches, from Croxton Manor cheese and pickle, to smoked salmon and cream cheese; freshly baked scones with clotted cream and strawberry conserve, and an array of sumptuous sweet treats. Highlights include an orange marmalade tea loaf and mango and white chocolate ice cake pops.  Afternoon Tea is accompanied by a choice of teas and infusions, which Hotel du Vin have developed with Bird & Blend Teas. For a special occasion, jazz up your Afternoon Tea with a glass of chilled Champagne.  Special dietary requirements are catered for, with alternative menus for vegetarians/vegans and for those with gluten and nut allergies. Pre-booking is required. Please specify dietary needs using the 'Special Request' field.  Afternoon Tea costs from £29.95 per person and is served Sunday to Tuesday from 3pm to 6pm, Wednesday and Thursday from 12pm to 6pm and Friday and Saturday from 12pm to 5pm. Bookings must be made in advance.
